name: Jefferson STEM Summer Camp Experience
description_short: Free three week engineering day camp on Jefferson's East Falls campus for students entering grades 6 to 9, Monday to Thursday. Campers analyze Eagles and Phillies stats with data science, write code, design parts in SolidWorks and 3D print them, and plan a mock supply chain. Admission is by application with a teacher recommendation.

sessions.name: STEM Summer Camp Experience, Monday to Thursday 8:30 to 3:00

notes: 2026: free, materials provided, August 3 to 20, Monday to Thursday 8:30 to 3:00. Students apply with a form and a letter of recommendation from a math or science teacher, emailed to the director, Dr. Fernando Tovia. Limited capacity. The page also calls it a camp for 6th graders; eligibility is entering grades 6 to 9 in 2026 to 2027. 2027 not yet posted.
